fusions.name: Ambush Spear
fusions.desc: Hurls a lance of arcana up to 10 tiles that deals 32 damage, rising to 1.8 times at full range, and leaves the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Whipping Tail
fusions.desc: Whips a ring of arcana around you that uses up one of your afflictions on each enemy within 2.5 tiles to deal 8 damage.

fusions.name: Sunwarmed Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Solar Charge
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 10% more damage.
